title: Way of Feng Shui
description: This game is a 3D house furnishing puzzle game where the player needs to follow the rules of Feng Shui to score points and pass the level. I was the programming lead of the team.

title: Mariposa
description: This is a narrative, puzzle-platformer that is released on Steam. I was the programming lead for the puzzles team who were in charge of implementing all the puzzles in game.

title: Vision Fridge
description: This is a mobile app that I developed during my internship at SDSC. Think Strava but food. This is a platform that allows users to follow recipes, share their cooking with their friends, and more.

title: Athenaeum
description: This deckbuilding roguelike was our club's first ever long term project. My main contribution was working on procedural generation for the map.
